title: Gabby Bear Tells a Story - Willie the World’s First Unigoat (1985 Select Merchandise, Inc.)
fulltitle: Gabby Bear Tells a Story - Willie the World’s First Unigoat (1985 Select Merchandise, Inc.)
description:
One of the more “infamous” knockoffs of Teddy Ruxpin released back in the 80s by Select Merchandise was Gabby Bear. This here is the story he’d initially come packed with (much like Teddy would be packed with The Airship), about his best friend; Willie, the World’s First Unigoat. 

Written by: Glen Olson & Rod Baker 
& Illustrated by: Gary Johnson. 
1985 Select Merchandise, Inc. 

Enjoy this unique, hard to find rarity. 🙂❤️ The rest of Gabby’s stories will be shared soon! 
(Fun Fact: Gabby was performed by Dick Beals, best known for his roles as Speedy Alkaseltzer, Gumby, & Davey in Davey & Goliath)
